continuous.rule: Only the principal sets this, in their own words about this program, with a link to the message. The framer never writes it. commanded false means one pass per invocation. An event trigger needs commanded true too.

rule: Builders may change only the passes field, from false to true, and set proof_ref, after the named proof exists. It is unacceptable to remove, reword, reorder, or add a unit here without a plan change recorded on the program thread. Verification steps are never edited by the builder.
